method: Every figure is measured like-for-like from nightly price snapshots of Bangladesh phone shops: official against official, import against import, one storage variant against the same variant, and a shop price gap only across three or more distinct shops.

packs.note: bhalophone.com · 2,366 phones, 48 nightly price checks since 2026-06-11
packs.caption:
Price drops we recorded in the last 30 days.

Every line compares like with like — the official price against the official price, the import price against the import price. When a cheap import listing sells out and the headline falls through to the official one, that is not a price cut, and it is not in this list.

This is the number the usual comparison gets wrong: quoting the cheapest official against the cheapest import usually compares 512GB against 256GB and doubles the gap. Every row here is one variant priced on both channels.
